Name: Upgrade BigChest
Author: Lizzeoeoeoe
Description:
现在，你可以使用一个宝箱，70个木材和2个铜锭来制作一个大箱子，这不会多耗费资源，也不会使用更少资源，一切都刚刚好，只是避免了宝箱的闲置
找了一圈都没有这种mod！所以0基础的我亲自操刀研究了一晚
很抱歉我不知道如何在罗宾的商店内添加这个配方，所以我把它设置成了默认获得的，这会损失一点沉浸感，我不是故意的，如果有人知道添加什么代码可以做到这些请留言帮助我，我会更新
抱歉未经允许使用了OchoEsLinda的Upgrade Sprinklers模组的代码进行修改，如有侵权请联系我下架模组
英语使用机翻致歉

Now, you can use a chest, 70 pieces of wood, and 2 copper ingots to make a large chest. This will not consume more resources, nor will it use fewer resources; everything is just right, just avoiding the idleness of the chestLooked everywhere and couldn't find this mod! So, with no prior experience, I took matters into my own hands and researched it all night
I'm sorry, I don't know how to add this recipe in Robin's store, so I set it to be obtained by default, which will lose a bit of immersion, it was not intentional. If anyone knows what code to add to do this, please leave a message to help me, I will update
I apologize for using the code from OchoEsLinda's Upgrade Sprinklers mod without permission and modifying it; if there is any infringement, please contact me to remove the mod
Sorry for the machine translation in English
